title: Malicious code in @c1-ease/core (npm)
description: The npm package @c1-ease/core contains malicious code that collects host identifiers during installation or import and sends them to a hardcoded external server. The package exports a no-op Proxy with no functional API, and its main observable effect is the transmission of installer environment data to a suspicious endpoint with disabled TLS verification. This behavior is consistent with dependency confusion or typo-squatting attacks.
